name: Assisi, the Basilica of San Francesco and Other Franciscan Sites
description: Assisi is a medieval hill town in Umbria, central Italy, perched on the slopes of Monte Subasio. It is the birthplace of Saint Francis, who founded the Franciscan Order here in 1208. Pilgrims and art lovers come for the great Basilica of San Francesco, whose walls hold paintings by Giotto, Cimabue, Simone Martini and Pietro Lorenzetti.
